Yesterday, that helps, that's still fresh in the queue, so nothing has gone missing. The team has it and will come back with the return label.

One thing they'll ask: was the unit ever overclocked or modified? That isn't covered by warranty, so good to clear it up now.

And what's it doing, no power, no hashrate, or something else?
